source: GameFAQs (section 'Wii VC Game Save File (North America)')
author: ConsummateGamer
what_it_is: JECE--slots 1, 2, and 3 are saved at convenient points for viewing endings 10, 11, and 12 respectively (Dino Age, What the Prophet Seeks ..., and A Slide Show?).

gamefaqs.section: Wii VC Game Save File (North America)

format: Wii data.bin (an SD-card export; header AES-128-CBC with the SD key, header MD5 valid): title 00010001-JECE "CHRONO TRIGGER", 1 file: savedata.bin 8192 bytes - savedata.bin is the SNES SRAM

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/wiivc-convert.py convert chrono-trigger.21937.bin OUT: decrypts the data.bin (AES-128-CBC, SD key, per-file IVs) and takes savedata.bin (8192 bytes): the SRAM, as is
verified.baseline: with no save: Start at the title begins a new game (Battle Mode screen)
